Mina: FYI sample-web prefetch + auth-retry = duplicate page hits during burst, second gets 429.
Omar: which SDK/version?
Mina: js-sample @redwood/sdk 2.2.0. Repro: fast scroll + force token expire.
Kelly: likely missing in-flight dedupe. Quick fix: singleflight map keyed by path+cursor.
Mina: verified: 120 rapid scrolls with 800ms token latency -> 19% 429s -> 0.5% with dedupe+jitter.
Omar: suggestion: add opt-in `dedupeInFlight` to JS SDK (default false), sample-app enable by default.
Kelly: add tests for concurrent callers, auth stub, and memory leak when many unique cursors.
devex-bot: created DEVEX-7122 "js-sdk: opt-in inflight dedupe" assigned @Omar
Mina: will open sample-app PR to enable and add onboarding note.
Omar: please also audit mobile sample.
Kelly: noted, will add to checklist.
